$sources: ASCE/SEI 7-22 Chapter 20 (site classification) with the SPT and su bands of ASCE/SEI 7-16 Table 20.3-1; ASCE 7-22 Sec 11.8.3 (liquefaction assessment) by the Youd et al. (2001) simplified procedure (SAEngine practice); the other groups are the extended pack's (IBC 2021 Sec 1803 asks for the investigation but gives no numbers), see VERIFY.md

liquefaction.note: ASCE 7-22 Sec 11.8.3 asks for an assessment of the liquefaction potential and gives no method: the simplified procedure of Youd et al. (2001), CSR = 0.65 (amax/g) rd σv/σ'v with CRR from the SPT, is SAEngine practice. Soil with a field N above the limit is taken as not liquefiable (rule of thumb).

sources.section: ASCE 7-22 Sec 11.8.3 (geotechnical investigation for Seismic Design Categories D to F: liquefaction)
sources.fs: Youd et al. (2001): FS = CRR / CSR (SAEngine practice)
sources.rd: Youd et al. (2001): rd = 1 - 0.00765 z (z up to 9.15 m), used at every depth (SAEngine practice, on the safe side below 9.15 m)
sources.csr: Youd et al. (2001): CSR = 0.65 (amax/g) rd σv/σ'v

siteClassification.note: ASCE 7-22 classes the site by vs30 (Table 20.2-1); without a measured vs the SPT N and su bands of ASCE 7-16 Table 20.3-1 give C, D or E (N above 50, 15 to 50, below 15; su above 2000 psf, 1000 to 2000, below 1000), over the top 100 ft, harmonic means, N at most 100 and su at most 5000 psf. Rock without a measured vs is taken as C (SAEngine practice: B and the 7-22 classes BC, CD and DE need the vs). More than 10 ft of soft clay (PI above 20, su below 500 psf) flags E; liquefiable soil flags F (a site response analysis, Sec 20.2.1); D is used meanwhile (SAEngine practice).

sources.table: ASCE 7-16 Table 20.3-1 and Sec 20.4 (N, su bands; harmonic means); ASCE 7-22 Table 20.2-1 (classes by vs30)
sources.nMax: ASCE 7-16 Sec 20.4.2: N at most 100 blows/ft
sources.rockClass: SAEngine practice: rock without a measured vs taken as C
